turns.question: Where is application-level route handling wired up, and is the router itself implemented inside this repository?
turns.text:
This confirms it: `router` is an external npm dependency (`"router": "^2.2.0"` in package.json), not implemented inside this repo. Let me check `application.js` more closely for how routes are wired (`app.get`, `app.use`, lazyrouter).I have enough evidence to answer confidently.
